values: 首次释放终极技能时，加布兽进化为钢铁加鲁鲁兽；后续释放终极技能时，钢铁加鲁鲁兽跳跃到目标格后使用“冰狱冷冻气”冻结面前大范围的敌人并使其持续失去生命值。

The first time Gabumon casts his Ultimate, he Digivolves into Metalgarurumon. On subsequent Ultimate casts, Metalgarurumon jumps to a target tile and uses Cocytus Breath, freezing enemies in a large frontal area and causing them to lose HP over time.

在战斗中，加布兽使用“爆炎火焰弹”作为普通攻击，对敌人造成100% ATK伤害。首次释放终极技能，加布兽会进化为钢铁加鲁鲁兽，永久提升40%攻击力和25点急速，并解锁其他技能。钢铁加鲁鲁兽释放终极技能时，跳到目标格子处，对4格长3格宽的范围内的敌人喷吐“冰狱冷冻气”，将他们冻结3秒。释放期间，敌人每0.5秒失去28% + 2% ATK生命值。
被动地，大和始终在场外处于无敌状态，并与自己的搭档并肩作战。战斗开始后以及每次释放终结技能时，大和会为搭档加油助威：使其提升15%的攻击力，持续5秒。该效果持续期间，若加布兽尚未进化为钢铁加鲁鲁兽，则每秒额外回复150点能量。

Gabumon uses Petit Fire as his normal attack, dealing 100% ATK damage to an enemy.
The first time Gabumon casts his Ultimate, he Digivolves into Metalgarurumon, permanently increasing his ATK by 40% and Haste by 25, and unlocking new skills.
When casting Ultimate as Metalgarurumon, he jumps to a target tile and unleashes Cocytus Breath in an area (4-tile long, 3-tile wide). This causes enemies within the area to lose 28% + 2% ATK HP every 0.5s and freezes them for 3s.
Passive. Yamato does not directly join the battle, remaining invincible on the sidelines. When a battle starts and whenever Gabumon casts his Ultimate, Yamato cheers for Gabumon, increasing Gabumon's ATK by 15% for 5s. While this effect is active, Gabumon recovers an extra 150 Energy every second if he has not yet Digivolved into Metalgarurumon.
“冰狱冷冻气” 释放期间，敌人每0.5秒失去的生命值提高至30% + 2% ATK。
Enemies affected by Cocytus Breath lose 30% + 2% ATK HP every 0.5s.
“冰狱冷冻气” 释放期间，敌人每0.5秒失去的生命值提高至32% + 2% ATK。
Enemies affected by Cocytus Breath lose 32% + 2% ATK HP every 0.5s.
“冰狱冷冻气” 释放期间，敌人每0.5秒失去的生命值提高至34% + 2% ATK。
Enemies affected by Cocytus Breath lose 34% + 2% ATK HP every 0.5s.
“冰狱冷冻气” 释放期间，敌人每0.5秒失去的生命值提高至36% + 2% ATK。
Enemies affected by Cocytus Breath lose 36% + 2% ATK HP every 0.5s.
对目标敌人发射导弹造成高额伤害，对附近的敌人造成较低伤害。
Metalgarurumon fires a Freeze Bomber at the target enemy, dealing heavy damage to them and lower damage to nearby enemies.
从胸部发射名为“冰冻炸弹”的巨大导弹，命中时对主目标造成360% + 48% ATK伤害，对其周围1格范围内的其他敌人造成180% + 24% ATK伤害。
Metalgarurumon fires a massive Freeze Bomber. Upon hitting the main target, it deals 360% + 48% ATK damage to them and 180% + 24% ATK damage to other enemies within 1 tile.
对主目标造成的伤害提升至400% + 48% ATK，对其周围1格范围内的其他敌人造成的伤害提升至200% + 24% ATK。
Increases damage to the main target to 400% + 48% ATK; increases damage to other enemies within 1 tile to 200% + 24% ATK.
对主目标造成的伤害提升至440% + 48% ATK，对其周围1格范围内的其他敌人造成的伤害提升至220% + 24% ATK。
Increases damage to the main target to 440% + 48% ATK; increases damage to other enemies within 1 tile to 220% + 24% ATK.
对主目标造成的伤害提升至480% + 48% ATK，对其周围1格范围内的其他敌人造成的伤害提升至240% + 24% ATK。
Increases damage to the main target to 480% + 48% ATK; increases damage to other enemies within 1 tile to 240% + 24% ATK.
提升自身的攻击和急速。
钢铁加鲁鲁兽仰天咆哮，使自身提升19% + 2.5%攻击和40点急速，持续16秒。
Metalgarurumon howls, increasing his ATK by 19% + 2.5% and Haste by 40 for 16s.
获得的攻击力加成提升至21% + 2.5%。
获得的攻击力加成提升至23% + 2.5%。
获得的攻击力加成提升至25% + 2.5%。
提升自身攻击回能，进化后，额外提升攻击回能。
Increases Energy recovery from attacks, and increases it further after Digivolving.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升18%，进化后，额外提升12%攻击回能。
Increases Energy recovery from attacks by 18% during battle. After Digivolving, increases Energy recovery from attacks by an extra 12%.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升24%，进化后，额外提升16%攻击回能。
Increases Energy recovery from attacks by 24% during battle. After Digivolving, increases Energy recovery from attacks by an extra 16%.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升30%，进化后，额外提升20%攻击回能。
Increases Energy recovery from attacks by 30% during battle. After Digivolving, increases Energy recovery from attacks by an extra 20%.
发射多枚小型导弹平均攻击所有敌人，对目标及周围敌人造成伤害。
Metalgarurumon fires multiple small missiles evenly at all enemies, dealing damage to each target and nearby enemies.
从身体各处发射10枚小型导弹平均地飞向所有敌人。导弹命中敌人时对其周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成60% ATK伤害，每次释放本技能后，每名相同敌人累计受到4次本技能的伤害时，后续伤害均降低50%。布阵时，自身周围1格范围内每有1名友军，则本技能发射的导弹数量永久增加2枚，最多增加6枚。

Metalgarurumon fires 10 small missiles, distributed evenly among all enemies. When a missile hits, it deals 60% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile of the target. During a single cast, if the same enemy has taken 4 hits from this skill, all subsequent hits on that enemy deal 50% less damage. During battle preparation, for each ally deployed within 1 tile of Gabumon, this skill permanently fires 2 more missiles, up to 6 extra missiles.
导弹命中敌人时对其周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成的伤害提升至70% ATK。
When a missile hits, it deals 70% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile of the target.
每次释放本技能后，每名相同敌人累计受到4次本技能的伤害时，该敌人会被立即冻结2秒，并受到360% ATK额外伤害。
During a single cast, if an enemy has taken 4 hits from this skill, that enemy is immediately frozen for 2s and takes 360% ATK extra damage.
导弹命中敌人时对其周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成的伤害提升至80% ATK。
When a missile hits, it deals 80% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile of the target.
加布兽在进化时，使周围的友军回复生命，自身获得攻击力加成。
When Gabumon Digivolves, nearby allies recover HP, and Gabumon gains an ATK bonus.
加布兽在进化时，爆发友情的羁绊，使自身和初始布阵在自身周围1格的友军每秒回复150% ATK生命值，持续8秒。该效果作用于亚古兽时，持续时间提升至12秒。每对一名友军施加该效果，自身永久提升5%攻击力，最高提升15%。

When Gabumon Digivolves, his Bond of Friendship activates. Gabumon and allies who were initially deployed within 1 tiles of him recover 150% ATK HP per second for 8s. If Agumon receives this effect, the duration is extended to 12s. For each ally affected, Gabumon permanently increases his ATK by 5%, up to 15%.
